newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real falls 0.13 pct on dollar outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real falls 0.13 pct on dollar outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.13 percent to close at 1.0695 per dollar on dollar outflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1645 local/1945 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $73 million deficit.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0732 per dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
